notes: DCA 6-2015 Table B3, Footing Sizes Based on Tributary Area for Various Soil Capacities (Appendix B, p. B5), transcribed 2026-09-27 (#42 slice B3) from the PDF in the guide's sources, read from the page rendered at 500 dpi in four crops and checked against the text extraction; both agree on all 300 cells. Appendix B offers it 'As an alternative to Table 4' (p. B2), and napkin uses it, not Table 4 (1,500 psf soil only), by the design note's decision 2. Each row is one Tributary Area (sq. ft.) row × one Soil Bearing Capacity column: the area an upper-bound band (domain min 1 sq ft is napkin's; the page prints none), the soil bearing a lower-bound band from 1500 psf — a site value below 1500 psf is Out of scope — to the last printed column, 3000 psf. Its outputs are the three printed cells, Round Footing Diameter (in.), Square Footing (in.) and Footing Thickness (in.). Note 1 sits on the title's 'Footing Sizes', so applies to every row (not-encoded); note 2 sits on the Tributary Area heading and is the table's centerPostFactor, 5/4, applied to a centre post under a continuous beam. Not yet reviewed: docs/code-packs/reviews/us-ct-2022/dca6-tableB3.md.
title: Footing Sizes Based on Tributary Area for Various Soil Capacities.

footnotes.text: Assumes 40 psf live load, 10 psf dead load, 150 pcf concrete and 2,500 psi compressive strength of concrete. Coordinate footing thickness with post base and anchor requirements.

centerPostFactor.text: Tributary area shall be multiplied by 1.25 at center posts with beams not spliced (continuous).
centerPostFactor.location: Table B3 note 2, p. B5 (its superscript on the Tributary Area heading)
